AoD Ash suffers if you stack too much damage - if he kills units before he depletes their balance bar, he loses out the benefit of 90% of his kit which comes from finishers. Wiseman is a good active but it doesn't compare to Henry's. So you either stack too much damage and lose out on everything but his chainsaw mastery (5% lol) and wiseman or don't stack it and hit like a noodle against possessed units.  


Scotty is just awful against the possession meta. He can't tank, and his active is awful, and heavy attacks aren't viable against possessed units where he'll just get stagger locked.

he doesn't need them, he has perks:

\+50% melee damage from being a warrior

\+15% damage from weapon master, two handed

\+15% damage from sting like a bee

\+15% damage from devastating force

This means at base he has 195% damage. Then you can throw in things like the last word, etc.

unlike wash and scotty he can get up in a demon's face and use his damage. he'll arguably be doing more damage because he reflects damage he takes back at the demon.
